facts.fact: Bluesquare says that from 30 June to 6 July 2025 a workshop with the Ministry of Health's e-Santé directorate set up the OpenHEXA interoperability platform on ministry servers, with a roadmap for production use and a second workshop planned for October-November 2025 for two use cases (SNIS to OpenHEXA to Superset, and ERA5 to OpenHEXA to DEDOP/NMDR).

systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique (Direction de la e-Santé)
